Hi Elsa / Mina / Marissa,

I've run the numbers and created a provisional credit memo (attached). Summary:
- Monthly charge per ephemeral GPU: $3,600.00
- Transfer date: 2027-03-09 (transfer effective at 11:45 AM PT). March billing cycle has 31 days.
- Days charged to Project Orion for those 6 GPUs: 9 full days (3/1 - 3/9 morning) -> charged fraction = 9/31.
- Days charged to Project Helix: remaining 22 days -> fraction = 22/31.

Credit calculation (Project Orion): 6 GPUs * $3,600 * (22/31) = $15,419.35 credit due back to Project Orion and re-applied to Project Helix.

Burst credit (one-off credit of $4,200 on 2027-03-03): we agree it should be reapportioned pro rata across active projects for March. Reallocation: Project Orion gets $1,700; Project Helix gets $2,500 (numbers included in credit memo).

Actions taken:
- Created FIN ticket FIN-2027-88 (internal).
- Generated credit memo: creditmemo_FIN-2027-88.pdf attached.
- Option A: Reissue March invoice (clean replacement) with credits applied — preferred for PO reconciliation.
- Option B: Post credit to your account and apply to April invoice.

Please confirm preference and provide VAT ID if you want the reverse-charge to be reflected on the reissued invoice. If you prefer a refund instead of account credit, note that refunds take 5-7 business days to process.
